lead.headline: Blake Corum scored 28.5. On Santa Clara’s bench.
lead.dek: Week 12’s first game is final, and the biggest number in R.A.T.S. belongs to a player who doesn’t count. The Finest kept Tuten, Bad things banked 16.9, and two more Finest calls lock Thu 1:30 PM. It’s 50.8% to 49.2%.
lead.pull: The best running back Santa Clara’s Finest had Wednesday night was the one it didn’t start.
body: Week 12 opened Wednesday night with one game, and Santa Clara’s Finest got the loudest performance in the league out of it. Blake Corum scored 28.5. Corum was on the bench. The scoreboard, which is not sentimental, has the Finest at 0.0.

The running-back call was the Wednesday-night lock this column flagged yesterday: Bhayshul Tuten or Kenneth Walker III, both Questionable, or Corum, the healthy floor. The Finest stayed with Tuten. I said start Corum only if both tags got worse. One did: Walker is now Out with a groin. Tuten is still Questionable, undisclosed, still starting and still projecting 15.18. I’ll take my share of that one.

Here’s the honest part: this isn’t a busted lineup. Tuten hasn’t played. He just has to do something nobody projects him to do, and the backup plan has thinned out. If Tuten sits, the Finest have no running back left on the bench. The wire does: Chris Rodriguez Jr., Tuten’s teammate, projects for 9.2, has been added 424,503 times across Sleeper, and is still unrostered in R.A.T.S.

Across the field, Bad things man bad things already has 16.9 on the board: Matthew Golden 4.9 and 12.0 from Los Angeles Rams D/ST in the defense slot. That’s the defense Bad things waived in this week’s claim run. Sleeper’s scoreboard is counting it anyway, while Sleeper’s roster page lists the slot as empty. I don’t make the rules. I just report the 12.0.

The Finest have two more clocks today. Stefon Diggs (13.12, Questionable, personal) and Isaiah Likely (14.52, Questionable, groin) both lock Thu 1:30 PM, and the bench answers are Denzel Boston (10.34, Questionable himself) and Ryan Flournoy (7.85). As set, the Finest project for 157.71 to Bad things’ 156.94. Nearly all of that edge runs through Questionable players.

Stakes: Santa Clara’s Finest are 3-8 with 25.7% playoff odds. Bad things man bad things are 8-3 and at 100%. One team is playing for seeding. The other is playing with a 28.5-point reminder on its bench.

quick_hits.headline: Poochinski plays 8 of 11 starters on Thanksgiving
quick_hits.body: Caleb Williams, Luther Burden III, Jahmyr Gibbs and Sam LaPorta in the morning game; Dak Prescott, CeeDee Lamb, Javonte Williams and Brandon Aubrey in the afternoon. By tonight Poochinski will have most of its 178.17 projection in the books, against deeboliciouskins’ 155.94 as set. That’s 66.9%. deeboliciouskins answers with D’Andre Swift, George Pickens and Patrick Mahomes today, and it still starts Kansas City Chiefs D/ST (5.53) with Minnesota Vikings D/ST (8.8) on the bench. The Chiefs play tonight.

quick_hits.headline: AB81’s ‘only sure thing’ scored 4.6
quick_hits.body: Yesterday this column called Matthew Stafford AB81’s only sure thing at quarterback. He scored 4.6. Kyren Williams saved the night with 16.5, so AB81 banked 21.1, and Big Stric Energy still flipped to a 57.6% favorite: 151.79 to 144.18. Big Stric’s own bench had Jordan Love at 10.62 behind Josh Allen and Geno Smith. Tucker Kraft scored 3.4 on that bench, so keeping Dalton Kincaid at tight end hasn’t cost a thing yet.

quick_hits.headline: What will AB81 do with Derrick Henry by 1:30?
quick_hits.body: Henry is back on the report: Questionable, concussion, 13.87 projected. The fix is a flex shuffle with DeVonta Smith (13.96), and Smith’s game locks Thu 1:30 PM, so this one can’t wait for Sunday news. Herbert is still Questionable with a concussion while Sam Darnold has shed his tag and projects for 15.51 on the bench. Set right, AB81 projects for 152.08, more than Big Stric’s best.

quick_hits.headline: Barkley or Braelon? Big Stric has till 1:30
quick_hits.body: Saquon Barkley (15.48) sits on the bench behind Braelon Allen (9.08), and Barkley’s game locks Thu 1:30 PM. Big Stric Energy is 2-9 with 3.5% playoff odds and four starters in tonight’s game: Josh Allen, Kincaid, Tyler Bass and Rashee Rice. Make the Barkley call and Big Stric goes into its Thanksgiving night at full strength.

quick_hits.headline: Maye banked Watson’s 16.5. Now it needs a QB plan.
quick_hits.body: Christian Watson scored 16.5 Wednesday night and is now listed Out with a concussion. His points count; the champ’s problems are elsewhere. Brock Purdy is Questionable with an ankle and there’s no quarterback on the bench. Deshaun Watson (16.03) is unrostered. Zay Flowers is Questionable too, and that call locks Fri 12:00 PM. Cherry Blossom leads the projections 166.15 to 161.45, 54.6%.

quick_hits.headline: Cherry Blossom brings the Detroit stack to dinner
quick_hits.body: Jared Goff, Jameson Williams and Jake Bates all play this morning, and Travis Kelce plays tonight. Kelce (9.52) is still starting over Brock Bowers (14.55, Questionable, ankle), but that call isn’t due until Sun 5:20 PM. Cherry Blossom can watch Kelce’s night before it decides.

w12-m1.headline: Big Stric flips to the favorite
w12-m1.blurb: AB81 banked 21.1 Wednesday, Big Stric 0.0, and the odds still moved Big Stric’s way: 57.6% on projections of 151.79 to 144.18. AB81’s best lineup is 152.08, but it needs the Henry call by Thu 1:30 PM and a healthy quarterback by Sun 1:25 PM. Big Stric just needs Barkley in.

w12-m2.headline: Cherry Blossom, with a Bowers option
w12-m2.blurb: Cherry Blossom 166.15, Maye I touch your TDs? 161.45 with Watson’s 16.5 already in. 54.6% Cherry Blossom. The champ has Purdy and Flowers Questionable and no backup quarterback; Cherry Blossom has Bowers waiting on the bench.

w12-m3.headline: Poochinski could wrap this up by dinner
w12-m3.blurb: Poochinski 178.17, deeboliciouskins 159.73 at its best. 66.9% Poochinski, and 8 of its 11 starters play today. deeboliciouskins needs its Sunday players to outscore a Thanksgiving it doesn’t control.

w12-m4.headline: I’m taking the 16.9 in hand
w12-m4.blurb: The Finest project for 157.71 to Bad things’ 156.94, 50.8%. But Tuten, Diggs and Likely are all Questionable and the bench is thin. Bad things has 16.9 banked and James Cook III tonight. Upset pick: Bad things.

w12-r1-s2.headline: Big Stric at RB: Barkley in
w12-r1-s2.blurb: Saquon Barkley (15.48, no tag) over Braelon Allen (9.08). Locks Thu 1:30 PM. Not close.

w12-r8-s2.headline: AB81 at RB: Henry or the shuffle?
w12-r8-s2.blurb: Henry (13.87) is Questionable with a concussion. DeVonta Smith (13.96) projects higher anyway and his game locks Thu 1:30 PM. George Kittle (12.06) is the Sunday fallback. I’d make the Smith move now.

w12-r8-s0.headline: AB81 at QB: Darnold’s tag is gone
w12-r8-s0.blurb: Herbert (13.78) is Questionable with a concussion. Darnold (15.51) no longer has a designation and projects higher. Due Sun 1:25 PM. It’s Darnold’s job to lose.

w12-r7-s3.headline: The Finest at RB: Tuten or the wire
w12-r7-s3.blurb: Tuten (15.18) is Questionable, undisclosed, and the bench has no running back left. Chris Rodriguez Jr. (9.2) is the insurance policy on the wire.

w12-r7-s5.headline: The Finest at WR: Diggs, Boston or Flournoy?
w12-r7-s5.blurb: Diggs (13.12, personal) and Boston (10.34, toe) are both Questionable; Flournoy (7.85) is healthy. Locks Thu 1:30 PM.

w12-r7-s6.headline: The Finest at TE: Likely or a flex shuffle
w12-r7-s6.blurb: Likely (14.52) is Questionable with a groin. The only cover is Flournoy (7.85) via a flex shuffle, and it locks Thu 1:30 PM.

w12-r3-s0.headline: Maye at QB: Purdy or the wire
w12-r3-s0.blurb: Purdy (16.18) is Questionable with an ankle and the bench has no quarterback. Deshaun Watson (16.03) is available.

w12-r3-s7.headline: Maye at FLEX: Flowers or London?
w12-r3-s7.blurb: Zay Flowers (16.49) is Questionable with an ankle; Drake London (14.47) is healthy. Locks Fri 12:00 PM.

w12-r4-s6.headline: Cherry Blossom at TE: Kelce plays first
w12-r4-s6.blurb: Kelce (9.52) plays tonight; Bowers (14.55) is Questionable. The call is due Sun 5:20 PM, after Kelce is done.

w12-r5-s4.headline: Bad things at WR: McMillan or Tyson?
w12-r5-s4.blurb: Tetairoa McMillan (14.24) is Questionable with a foot; Jordyn Tyson (11.82) is healthy. Due Sun 10:00 AM.
